title: What's New in OpenReel: Platform Enhancements & Features
summary: What's New in OpenReel: Platform Enhancements & Features
body_markdown:
**A refreshed platform experience, more flexible video creation, and smarter ways to manage your content. Explore the latest OpenReel enhancements designed to make your workflow easier.**


At OpenReel, we're always looking for ways to make remote video creation simpler, more flexible, and more efficient. Whether you're capturing user-generated content (UGC), collaborating with a team, or managing a growing library of video assets, the tools you use should make your work easier.


That's why we're continuing to enhance the OpenReel platform with improvements designed around the way you work.


From a refreshed platform experience and more flexible recording capabilities to streamlined editing and smarter content management, here's a look at what's new.


## **A More Modern OpenReel Experience**


We're continuing our platform redesign to create a more modern, intuitive, and scalable experience. We've made significant updates to several key areas to help you navigate the platform and access the tools you need more easily.


#### **Library Refreshed**


Finding and managing your content is now easier with an updated three-column Library layout. Larger content tiles provide a cleaner browsing experience, helping you quickly locate the videos and assets you need.


#### **Navigation Simplified**


We've streamlined platform navigation to make frequently used tools easier to find.


- Account settings and account switching are now accessible from your avatar.
- The accessibility button is conveniently located in the sidebar.
- Help resources are consolidated behind one easy-to-find help button.
- Support chat remains accessible in the bottom-right corner.


#### **Project Page Redesigned**


Your projects now have a more streamlined layout, with Sessions, Scripts, Creator, and Team Members accessible directly from the sidebar.


We've also improved how you work with individual clips. Instead of opening in a small pop-up window, clips now have their own dedicated page, making important actions easier to see and access at a glance.


The result? A cleaner workspace that helps you spend less time navigating and more time creating.


## **🤳 Record and Submit Multiple UGC Clips in One Session**


Creating authentic user-generated content just got better.


Following our UGC experience redesign, you can once again record and submit as many clips as you need within a single session.


This flexibility is available across all three session types:


- **Simple:** Capture content without a script or structured prompts.
- **Script:** Follow a provided script while recording your content.
- **Questions:** Respond to guided questions to capture authentic feedback and perspectives.


Whether you're gathering customer testimonials, capturing multiple product reactions, or collecting a series of short-form videos, you can keep recording without starting a new session for every clip.


More flexibility means a smoother recording experience and fewer interruptions to your creative process.


## **📄 Present Multiple PDFs in Studio**


Need to share more than one presentation during a recording session? Now you can.


OpenReel Studio supports multiple file uploads, allowing you to upload several PDF documents and present them one after another.


Whether you're switching between your own presentations or handing off to another presenter, you can move between documents without disrupting the flow of your session.


It's a simple enhancement that makes presentations, interviews, and collaborative recording sessions easier to manage.


## **Start Creator Edits Directly From Your Project**


Editing your video content just became more convenient.


You can now start a Creator edit directly from an existing project page. There's no need to create a separate project using a template before you begin.


Simply open your project, add a new edit, and choose how you'd like to get started:


- **Start with a blank canvas:** Build your edit from scratch.
- **Use a template:** Select one of your existing templates to get started faster.


By bringing Creator editing directly into your project workflow, you can keep your content and editing activities more organized while reducing unnecessary steps.


## **🛎️ Stay in the Loop With In-App Notifications**


In-app notifications make it easier to keep up with important platform updates.


A new bell icon in the sidebar gives you access to relevant updates without having to leave the OpenReel platform.


You can also manage your notification preferences directly from Settings, giving you more control over the updates you receive.


It's another way we're making it easier to stay informed and focused on your work.


## **Replace Uploaded Videos Efficiently**


Already shared a video with customers, prospects, or your audience, but need to update the content?


Now you can replace an uploaded video directly within the OpenReel Library without having to distribute new links.


When you replace an uploaded video:


- Existing share links remain unchanged.
- Embed codes continue working as expected.
- Analytics stay intact.
- Only the video content is updated.


This is especially helpful when you need to refresh a video that's already embedded on your website or shared across marketing channels.


**One important note:** This functionality currently applies to uploaded videos only.


You can update your content while keeping the connections, distribution, and performance history associated with your original video.


## **Keep Creating With OpenReel**


These enhancements reflect our ongoing commitment to making OpenReel a more flexible, intuitive, and powerful platform for remote video creation.


Whether you're recording UGC, presenting content in Studio, editing videos in Creator, or managing your video library, we're continuing to build tools that help you work smarter and create with confidence.


We're excited for you to explore what's new!


**Ready to see the latest OpenReel enhancements in action?**


Log in to your[OpenReel account](https://www.openreel.com/#:~:text=Start%20for%20Free-,Login,-%231%20Remote%20Video) and explore the updated experience.
